flags: PHONE (apply.py does not write it): add 785-598-2352 (operator site, Google Maps). The entry has no phone.
WEBSITE: stored https://www.walts4seasonscamp.com live (redirects to https://walts4seasonscamp.com/); operator's own site. Booking page https://walts4seasonscamp.com/online-bookings/.

PRIVATE GATE FACTS: cheapest RV night $44 (30 A water/electric back-in, Wed 2026-11-18; full hookup $48), $48/$52 on a June 2027 weekday; under $50. 3% surcharge applies only to card payments (cash/check/ACH exempt), so not counted. No gateway within 40 km (moot). Presence: working website + phone; Google 4.7 from 308 reviews; RV Life 4.5 $$. Good Sam stored false (directory). Family has not stayed here.

LONG-STAY: the operator courts both overnighters and long-termers ('Working the region for a season?'; 'Weekly Plus' full-time program, metered electric, $150 deposit, 10-year rig-photo rule for long-term sites only). Test 1: no sites said to be seasonal-only; test 2: nightly rates live on a booking engine; test 3: no lots for sale; test 4: the engine offered 34 RV sites in five nightly categories for one November night; test 5: nightly stays need no approval. Passes; a family campground, not long-stay in character.

WATERFRONT LEAD (not changed): the operator advertises '8 water & electric sites on the pond' ('sit right along our stocked fishing pond'). Imagery shows two small ponds, both far under 5 acres: one ~40 x 75 m (~0.6 acre) between the store and the bathhouse, one ~75 x 25 m (~0.4 acre) north of the loops in open grass. I could not see RV pads beside either on the Esri or NAIP frames (the pond-side sites may postdate the imagery), so 'pond' is not earned from imagery; not waterfront kept. If AWH wants it pursued, the operator's site map (Directions & Site Map) would show where the 8 sites are.

PIN: stored 38.9595,-97.1112 is at the Country Store / fuel stop entrance (Google's pin 38.95984,-97.11077 too); the RV loops lie ~100-350 m north, centroid about 38.9615,-97.1105 (~220 m). Under the 250 m line; optional move.

SITES: count 64 = 56 full-hookup + 8 pond-side W/E RV sites (tent sites and the park-owned 'Cabin on Wheels' excluded). '~80 feet' is a pull-through length, not a stated rig limit, so max_rig_ft not written.
